title: Repeat
description: Arm a symmetry once and every shape you draw arrives with its copies: wallpaper tilings, polar rings, bands, and more.

bubble.title: Repeat: draw once, get the pattern
bubble.body: Repeat is a symmetry engine. Arm it, pick a family and a group, and every shape you draw is deposited with its copies — tiled, ringed, or banded — as one retained record you can revisit.

bubble.title: Watch: a polar ring, live
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program chooses the Polar family, arms Repeat live while drawing, and draws one small rectangle — six copies ring it as it lands.

demo.title: The Polar family
demo.body: Choosing Polar: copies rotate around a centre. Six divisions, so five copies join the original.

demo.title: Armed live
demo.body: Arming Repeat live while drawing — the next shape lands with its whole ring.

demo.title: One draw, six shapes
demo.body: A single small rectangle, deposited as a ring of six. The copies are one record on the shape, not six loose shapes.

bubble.title: Choose the Wallpaper family
bubble.body: In the Repeat section, set Family to Wallpaper. Wallpaper tiles the plane — the family of the plain grid and the classic patterns.

bubble.title: Choose the plain grid group
bubble.body: Set the wallpaper Group to the one labelled o — the plain grid: copies in rows and columns, nothing rotated or mirrored. (The labels are Conway's orbifold signatures; the section stores the group as p1.)

bubble.title: Arm it live
bubble.body: Check Repeat live while drawing in the Repeat section.

bubble.title: Draw the motif
bubble.body: Draw a small shape with I — a rectangle is fine. It lands as a grid of copies: one drawing, tiled.

bubble.title: Progressions and outcomes
bubble.body: Under Progressions, each copy can step or grow by an equation — arithmetic or geometric. Whorl and Phyllotaxis are ready-made outcomes there: choose one and its numbers (the golden angle, for phyllotaxis) fill in.

bubble.title: The record stays on the shape
bubble.body: Uncheck Repeat live while drawing when you are done. Select a repeated shape later and this section shows its descriptor again — Regenerate replays it, Expand repeat keeps the copies as ordinary shapes.
